listening.title: Làm việc với kiểm toán viên

lines.speaker: Khoa (Kiểm toán viên)
lines.text: Good morning. Can we start with the audit scope for this quarter?

lines.speaker: Linh (Kế toán)
lines.text: Sure, we agreed to cover revenue and expenses mainly.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Kiểm toán viên)
lines.text: Great. I'll send you an evidence request list by email today.

lines.speaker: Linh (Kế toán)
lines.text: Okay, I'll prepare the documents before our walkthrough tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Kiểm toán viên)
lines.text: Thanks. What sample size are you using for the invoice testing?

lines.speaker: Linh (Kế toán)
lines.text: We're testing about thirty invoices this quarter, as usual.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Kiểm toán viên)
lines.text: Understood. I found one control weakness in the approval process.

lines.speaker: Linh (Kế toán)
lines.text: Can you explain what exactly went wrong there?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Kiểm toán viên)
lines.text: Two invoices were paid without a second signature.

lines.speaker: Linh (Kế toán)
lines.text: I see. Will that be an exception noted in the report?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Kiểm toán viên)
lines.text: Yes, but it's minor. We can still issue a clean opinion overall.

lines.speaker: Linh (Kế toán)
lines.text: That's a relief. We'll fix the process before next year's management letter.
